summary: The original issue reproduces on the prepared base, and candidate f57cca7f3edc7efc131c940777f02600e4717649 fixes only diagnostic behavior. The exact plain-global BufferCopy32/64/128 fx.gemm variants still fail, while the VGPR gap remains 24 raw versus 28 UniversalCopy fx.gemm. The candidate adds actionable descriptor/width diagnostics and changes the descriptor-backed BufferCopy128 mismatch from an LLVM abort to a clean compile error. Descriptor-backed BufferCopy32/64 already compile on the base and candidate and use 26 VGPR.

tests.what_was_measured: Base matrix: raw and UniversalCopy compiled; exact plain-global BufferCopy32/64/128 failed with exit 1; descriptor-backed 32/64 compiled; descriptor-backed 128 aborted with exit 134. Final gfx942 ISA reported raw=24, UniversalCopy fx.gemm=28, descriptor-backed 32=26, and descriptor-backed 64=26 VGPR. Raw evidence: /job/review-evidence/base.

Rebuilt candidate C++ against pinned LLVM e2a39f504fee836e4def9581bed817ecc327b9dc; repo native path was switched to /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-d95d9d896ee3/native-build/python_packages/flydsl/_mlir. The included gfx950 vector-add GPU numerical smoke passed. Metadata: /job/review-evidence/candidate/native-build.json.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate matrix: exact plain-global 32/64/128 still failed but gained actionable descriptor diagnostics; descriptor-backed 32/64 compiled; descriptor-backed 128 became a clean 128-bit-versus-vector<8xi8> error instead of aborting. VGPR counts were unchanged from base. Raw evidence: /job/review-evidence/candidate.
Candidate regression verified load/store width mismatch diagnostics and plain-global source/destination diagnostics using the rebuilt fly-opt.

Adversarial boundaries: exact vector<16xi8> BufferCopy128 load/store cases lowered to i128 buffer operations, while an oversized vector<8xi8> result for BufferCopy32 was rejected with the expected width diagnostic. Exact valid sections separately exited 0.

remaining_limitations: The available GPU was AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, not the issue's gfx942. The original gfx942 kernels were compiled and their ISA inspected but were not numerically executed.
The successful GPU execution was the native rebuild's independent vector-add smoke; it validates the rebuilt library on gfx950 but is not evidence that the gfx942 fp8 GEMM issue is solved.
The exact original BufferCopy32/64/128 programs still fail because they pass plain global tensors to descriptor-only atoms.
The candidate does not address fx.gemm VGPR overhead: 28 VGPR versus 24 for raw MFMA with UniversalCopy32b on this prepared revision.
BufferCopy128b cannot match this tiled MMA's 64-bit per-lane fragment; the candidate diagnoses rather than changes that contract.
